DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届をこちらで提出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you submit your moving-in notification here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。これを出せば、子どもの学校にも新住所が伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入届で学校へ自動連絡されるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I submit it, will my child's school also be told the new address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a moving-in notification automatically informs the school. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転入の手続きと、学校などへの連絡はそれぞれ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Moving-in procedures and notifying schools and other organizations each need checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一度出せば全部へ伝わると思っていました。学校の連絡先も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全部に伝わると思った誤解と学校窓口の案内希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought submitting once informed everyone. I would also like guidance on the school's contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the assumption that everyone is informed and ask for a school contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象のお子さんは一緒に引っ越されたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The child concerned moved with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、子どもも一緒です。大人の私だけの転入として説明しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子も同時転居する対象だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my child too. I will not explain this as only me, the adult, moving in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your child is also moving at the same time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 学校に関する窓口をご案内します。ほかに変更したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will direct you to the school-related counter. Is there anything else you want to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電気の契約もありますが、それは契約先へ別に連絡します。市へ出したことだけで済ませません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電気契約は別途契約先へ連絡すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My electricity contract too, but I will contact that company separately. I will not consider submitting to the city sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will notify the electricity supplier separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はどの順で相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: In what order would you like to ask today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず転入届、それから学校の窓口です。手続きごとの控えと次にすることを分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届出と学校相談の順序と個別の控え確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: First the moving-in notification, then the school desk. I want to check each procedure's record and next action separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the notification-then-school order and separate confirmation copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。転入の内容を確認して、次の窓口を案内します。契約先への変更は別にお進めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the moving-in details and direct you to the next desk. Please proceed separately with contract-provider changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、明日の検査を来週へ変えたいです。準備は今夜から始めるよう説明を受けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日の検査を翌週へ変えたいと準備予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I want to move tomorrow's test to next week. I was told to begin preparation tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to move tomorrow's test to next week and give the preparation schedule. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 準備について、すでに実施したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already done any preparation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼から食事の内容を変えました。予約だけ変えれば準備も同じままでよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既に食事を変え準備継続を当然と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I changed my meals from lunchtime. I thought changing only the booking meant I could keep preparation the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you already changed meals and assumed preparation should continue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査担当に状況を伝えて確認します。お薬についての指示もありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell the testing staff and check. Were there medication instructions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありますが、自分で変更しません。受け取った説明書を見ながら担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬を自己変更せず説明書で担当相談すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I will not change it myself. I want to consult the staff while looking at the instruction sheet I received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not change medicine yourself and will consult using the instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更する理由を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us why you want to change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日は付き添いが来られません。付き添いが必要かも含め、日時と準備を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付き添い不在が理由で必要性も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion cannot come tomorrow. I want to check the date and preparation, including whether a companion is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the absent companion as the reason and ask whether accompaniment is necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。変更後の準備をまだ同じように続けないで、具体的な案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will connect you with the staff member. Do not simply continue the same preparation after changing; obtain specific instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。実施したことを伝え、今夜どうすればよいかも担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既実施内容と今夜の準備の具体的案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will tell them what I have already done and ask what to do tonight too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for specific guidance on preparations already done and tonight's actions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約の変更可否、付き添い、準備の扱いを担当がそれぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff member will separately check whether the appointment can change, accompaniment, and preparation handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 置いた自転車が見当たらないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bicycle you parked is missing, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、近くに撤去の掲示があるので、もう持って行かれたのだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撤去掲示で自転車も撤去済みと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a removal notice nearby, so I think it has already been taken away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a removal sign made you think your bicycle had been removed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示は一般の注意ですか。実際の撤去記録を確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it a general warning? Have you checked actual removal records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 記録は確認していません。駐輪しないでくださいという看板だけ見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一般の看板だけで実記録は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No records checked. I only saw a no-parking sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw only a general sign and no actual records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一般の案内だけで、その自転車が撤去されたとは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: A general notice alone does not confirm that particular bicycle was removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。置いた場所と時間を伝え、撤去の確認先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐輪情報を伝えて撤去確認の窓口を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will give where and when I parked; please tell me whom to ask about removal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give parking details and ask the removal-checking contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで相談を伺い、管理の窓口も案内します。自転車の特徴はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will hear your inquiry here and show you the management contact too. Do you know the bicycle's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 緑の車体で後ろに子ども用の座席があります。登録の番号も控えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体と子ども座席と登録控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: A green frame with a child seat at the back. I also have its registration number written down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the frame, child seat, and registration record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理側へ確認した結果も、相談時にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us the result of checking with management when discussing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。撤去されていないとわかっても、すぐ盗難と断定せず、確認結果を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果を共有し未撤去だけで盗難と断定しないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Even if it was not removed, I will not immediately conclude theft; I will report what was confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the result without concluding theft solely from non-removal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。掲示、実際の記録、車体の情報を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the sign, actual records, and bicycle information separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類の送り先はこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the document destination, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、同じ建物なので、別の部署の書類も一つの封筒に入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同住所の別部署書類を一封筒にしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is the same building, so I put documents for another department in one envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say documents for different departments at one address were put in one envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの提出案内には、どの宛先が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: What addressee does each submission instruction give?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは受付係、もう一つは審査係です。住所が同じなら一緒でよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付係と審査係の宛先違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One says reception and the other examination section. I thought the same address meant they could go together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out different addressees for reception and examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中でどのように受け付けるかは提出先に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to ask the destination how they accept documents internally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。郵便局が二つの部署へ分けてくれるとは思わず、案内元に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内部振分を郵便局へ任せず提出先に確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not assume the post office separates them for two departments; I will check with the source of the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not leave internal sorting to the post office; check with the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ封は閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you not sealed it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉じていません。個別に送る指定なら、二つの封筒と宛名を準備し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未封で個別指定なら封筒を分け直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. If separate sending is required, I will prepare two envelopes and addresses again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is unsealed and you will separate envelopes if individually required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送記録が必要かも、案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check whether the instructions require a shipping record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二つに分ける場合は、それぞれの記録と控えがわかるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別発送時の記録と控えを対応させたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If splitting them, I want to match each one's record and retained copy clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to match separate shipping records and copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。提出条件を確認して梱包を決めた後、各封筒の発送方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. After checking submission conditions and deciding packaging, ask about mailing methods for each envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を新しく作られたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to create a new account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも昔この銀行で使った通帳があり、今も残っているかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昔の通帳があり口座状態不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I have an old passbook from this bank and do not know whether the account still exists.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have an old passbook and the account status is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 既存の口座の状況を先に確認しましょう。通帳をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the existing account status first. Have you brought the passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。長く使っていないので、解約されたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未利用を解約済みと思ったと説明し通帳を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. I thought it had been closed because I had not used it for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the passbook and explain that you mistook non-use for closure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使っていないことだけで状態は判断できません。本人確認資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Non-use alone does not determine the status. Do you have identity documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。自分で古い口座を使えると決めず、状態と手続きの案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人資料を示して使用可否と手続確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not decide myself that the old account is usable. Please explain its status and procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show identity documents and ask to check usability and procedures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が調べます。新しい口座を希望する理由は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will investigate. Why do you want a new account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 生活費を分けたいからです。新規開設できるかと、古い口座をどう扱うかを一緒に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 生活費を分ける目的と新旧口座の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: To separate my living expenses. I want to discuss both whether I can open a new one and what to do with the old one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain separating living expenses and ask about both new and old accounts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件を確認します。通帳の記載住所は現在と違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the conditions. Is the passbook's recorded address different from your current one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 違います。住所の変更も伝えますが、口座が新しくできたこととは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧住所相違を伝え住所変更と新規開設を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will report the address change too, but check it separately from a new account being opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the old-address difference and distinguish address change from new opening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。既存の状態、登録情報、ご利用目的を確認してから担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff member will check existing status, registered information, and intended use before explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値段を確認しましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、安い棚から取りましたが、同じ物の別の棚では高いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同商品らしい二棚の価格差を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I took it from a cheap shelf, but another shelf for what looks like the same item has a higher price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a price difference between two shelves apparently for the same item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名と容量を値札と比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the product name and quantity with the price tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この棚の値札は小さい容量でした。誰かが戻した所から取ったので、場所だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 値札は小容量で戻された位置だけを見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This shelf's tag was for a smaller size. I took it from where someone had returned it and only looked at the position.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the tag was for a smaller size and you looked only at the returned item's position. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品の表示を確認します。小さい容量のほうをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check this product's label. Would you prefer the smaller size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、今日は少量で十分です。今の大きい商品は、どこへ戻せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量希望を示し大商品を正しく戻す場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, a small amount is enough today. Where should I return this large product correctly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want a small amount and ask where to return the large item properly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 正しい棚はこちらです。必要ならこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The correct shelf is here. We can take it for you if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではお願いします。安い値札の所へまた戻さず、正しい小さい商品を確認して取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤棚へ戻さずスタッフへ渡して小容量を取りたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please do. I will not return it to the cheap tag again; I want to check and take the correct small item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give it to staff rather than the wrong shelf and ask to take the small size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい商品の名称と容量を案内します。支払額も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show the small product's name and quantity. Would you like to check the payment amount too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、棚の位置だけではなく、名前と容量と価格が合うかを見てから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名と容量と価格を照合して購入すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not buy based only on shelf position; I will check that the name, quantity, and price match first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will match name, quantity, and price before purchasing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取り違えた商品をお預かりし、必要な容量のものをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will take the mistaken item and show you the quantity you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帰りの道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、ベンチが向いている方に出口があると思ったのですが、見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベンチ方向を出口方向と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought the exit was in the direction the bench faces, but I cannot see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you treated the bench direction as the exit direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ベンチの向きは道の案内ではありません。入った入口を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bench's direction is not route guidance. Do you remember which entrance you used?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は覚えていません。池を見ながら座り、その向きで道を判断していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口名は不明で池を向く座席で判断したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember its name. I sat facing the pond and judged the route from that direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the entrance name is unknown and you judged by the pond-facing seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内板で今の位置を確認しましょう。帰りは駅へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your current location on the information board. Are you going to the station on the way home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、駅へ行きます。入った入口を探すだけでなく、駅へ出られる出口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅へ行ける出口の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than just search for the entrance I used, please tell me an exit that leads to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an exit leading to the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる道と出口を確認します。もう休憩が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check available paths and exits. Do you need another rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し休んでから行きます。道を確かめず同じ所を歩き回るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休んでから出発し未確認のまま歩き回らないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will rest a little before leaving. I want to avoid walking around the same area without checking the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will rest before departure and avoid wandering without confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発する前に目印も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also check landmarks before you set off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。ベンチの向きではなく、案内板と途中の表示を使って進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座席向きではなく案内板と経路表示を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will use the information board and signs along the way rather than the bench's orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use boards and route signs rather than seat orientation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在地、駅へ向かう出口、途中の目印を順にお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will show your current location, the station-side exit, and landmarks in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換え先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この駅です。同じ名前の駅に着けばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名だけで乗換先を選んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This station. I thought I only had to reach a station with the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you chose the transfer destination by station name alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅名に加えて、路線名も確認しましょう。案内に路線名はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the line name as well as the station. Is a line name in the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。友人から聞いた路線と違います。駅名だけメモしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内路線が友人の情報と違い路線未記録と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It differs from the line my friend mentioned. I only noted the station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the listed line differs from your friend's information and you did not record it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人との待ち合わせ場所は、どの路線の改札ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which line's ticket gates are you meeting your friend at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。先に友人へ路線と改札を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に待合せ路線と改札を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not asked yet. I will check the line and gate with my friend first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your friend the meeting line and gate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れたら、そこへの経路を調べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once confirmed, we can check the route there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。違う路線の駅へ着いてから歩けるか探すより、今の場所から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着後に探さず現在地で経路を確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would rather check from here than reach a different line's station and then search for a walkable connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the route now rather than search after arrival. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご友人から返事はありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この路線の北改札です。路線名と改札名を一緒にメモしました。ここからの乗り換えを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み路線と北改札を示して経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the north gate of this line. I noted the line and gate names together. Please tell me how to transfer from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the confirmed line and north gate and ask the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できた待ち合わせ場所への経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will explain the route to the confirmed meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出先の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the destination's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、原本返却とあるので、コピーを出すつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本返却をコピー提出可と理解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says the original will be returned, so I intended to submit a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you interpreted return of the original as permission to submit a copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原本を提出して返却されるのか、コピー提出でよいのかは別の条件です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Submitting an original and having it returned is a different condition from allowing a copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。返すという文字だけで、原本はいらないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却表示から原本不要と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's true. I saw only the word return and thought the original was unnecessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the return label made you wrongly think no original was needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な証明の種類と、提出方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the certificate type and submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 種類はこの案内です。コピーでよいかは提出先へ聞き、まず指定の証明を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 種類を示し提出方法は提出先へ確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The type is in these instructions. I will ask the destination whether a copy is acceptable; first I want to ask about the specified certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the type and say you will check the submission method with the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 証明の記載項目にも指定がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there requirements for the certificate fields too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。返却予定だからと項目を省かず、案内通りの内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却予定でも指定記載項目を省かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not omit fields just because it will be returned; I want to check the contents as instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not omit required fields even if return is planned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請に必要な資料を担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain documents needed for application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。受け取った後は自分の控えを作り、提出する原本と分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取後に自分の控えと提出原本を分けると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. After receiving it, I will make my own copy and keep it separately from the original to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate your retained copy from the original for submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行条件と提出先の条件をそれぞれ確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please check issuance conditions separately from the destination's submission conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲酒の欄は、なしでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is none correct in the alcohol field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日は飲んでいないので、なしと書きました。普段は週に二回ほど飲みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日未飲酒だが普段週二回と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I did not drink yesterday, so I wrote none. Normally I drink about twice a week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say no drinking yesterday but normally twice weekly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日のことと普段の頻度を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check yesterday separately from your usual frequency.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、普段飲まないという回答になってしまったので、記入を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普段なしとなった記入の訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My answer now says I do not normally drink, so I want to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to correct an entry implying you normally never drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 普段飲む量も説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you explain your usual quantity too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一回で缶を一本です。缶の大きさが一定ではないので、一本だけでは量が伝わりにくいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 缶一本だが容量一定でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: One can per occasion. The can sizes are not always the same, so just saying one can does not convey the amount clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain one can but variable volume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかる範囲で容量や種類も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give the volume and type as far as you know too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: よく飲む缶の表示を写真で確認できます。記憶で全部同じ量と決めず、普段の例として示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示写真を普段の一例として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can check a label photo of a can I often drink. I will not assume from memory every serving is identical; I will show it as a usual example.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show a label photo as one usual example. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に飲んだ日は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you remember when you last drank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三日前です。昨日飲まなかったこと、最後に飲んだ日、普段の頻度を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨日の状態と最終飲酒日と通常頻度を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three days ago. I will distinguish not drinking yesterday, the last drinking date, and my usual frequency.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate yesterday's situation, last drinking date, and usual frequency. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今確認できる情報を記録し、必要な点は診療担当から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record information confirmable now, and clinical staff will ask any necessary further questions.
